commands:
set -e
EXPECTED_SHA="15931fa8341784a308f8a8b9ea6ebd68279241fc"
ENDPOINT="192.168.0.100:40503"

git fetch origin main --quiet
git checkout --detach "$EXPECTED_SHA" >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"

APK="$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*.apk' -type f | head -n1)"
if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
  export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"
  ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug
  APK="$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*.apk' -type f | head -n1)"
fi
test -n "$APK"

adb kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
adb start-server >/dev/null

echo "ADB_CONNECT_TARGET=$ENDPOINT"
adb connect "$ENDPOINT" || true
sleep 2
adb devices

MODEL="$(adb -s "$ENDPOINT" shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)"
if [ "$MODEL" != "SM-S906B" ]; then
  echo "DIRECT_ENDPOINT_MODEL_MISMATCH_OR_UNREACHABLE model=$MODEL"
  adb connect "Android-2.local:40503" || true
  sleep 2
  MODEL="$(adb -s "Android-2.local:40503" shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)"
  if [ "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B" ]; then
    ENDPOINT="Android-2.local:40503"
  fi
fi

test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"
echo "S22_CONNECTED endpoint=$ENDPOINT model=$MODEL"

OUT="$(adb -s "$ENDPOINT" install --no-streaming -r "$APK" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"

test -n "$(adb -s "$ENDPOINT" shell pm path io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' | head -n1)"
adb -s "$ENDPOINT" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null
sleep 1
PID="$(adb -s "$ENDPOINT" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' | head -n1)"
test -n "$PID"

printf 'FINAL_INSTALL_OK sha=%s endpoint=%s model=SM-S906B package=io.blueeye data_preserved=yes app_running=yes pid=%s\n' "$EXPECTED_SHA" "$ENDPOINT" "$PID"
